project.name: DUGate (Document Understanding API Gateway)
project.description: Enterprise Document AI Gateway - API Gateway nội bộ chuyên xử lý bài toán Document Understanding cho môi trường doanh nghiệp, đặc biệt ngành Tài chính & Ngân hàng. Quy chuẩn hóa 7 API Endpoint với BullMQ Pipeline Engine bất đồng bộ

architecture.pattern: API Gateway Pattern with Pipeline Engine and Profile-Driven Routing
architecture.database: PostgreSQL 16 with Drizzle ORM (9 tables), Redis for BullMQ queues
architecture.api_style: REST API - 7 core endpoints: ingest, extract, analyze, transform, generate, compare, workflows
architecture.auth_method: Dual Auth: NextAuth JWT (UI) + API Key authentication (x-api-key header) + OIDC/SSO support
architecture.hosting: Docker Compose (app + worker + redis), PostgreSQL external
notes: Asynchronous Pipeline Engine with BullMQ workers (pipeline queue + workflow-steps queue)
Profile-driven routing - Admin can override AI connections, prompts, parameters per API Key
Multi-AI backend support (Google Gemini, OpenAI, Claude)
File deduplication via MD5 hash + S3 storage

decisions.title: Migration from Prisma to Drizzle ORM
decisions.decision: Migrated to Drizzle ORM for better TypeScript support and performance
decisions.status: In Progress - Prisma folder still exists for reference

decisions.title: BullMQ for Job Queue
decisions.decision: Using BullMQ with Redis for async job processing with 2 queues (pipeline + workflow-steps) to avoid deadlocks

decisions.title: Standalone Worker Process
decisions.decision: Separate worker.ts process for better scalability and graceful shutdown

decisions.title: Image input support & per-endpoint allow-list
decisions.decision: Added image input support. Global default allow-list = PDF + Gemini-2.5 image set (jpg/jpeg/png/webp/heic/heif). ENDPOINT_ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS map is a ZERO-REGRESSION SUPERSET: every endpoint keeps pdf+docx (as before) and only ADDS images (+sheets where relevant), so no existing production caller breaks. Priority: Profile > registry endpoint policy > global default.

decisions.title: Removed orphaned doc-compare feature
decisions.decision: doc-compare was never wired into SERVICE_REGISTRY/WORKFLOW_REGISTRY (returned 404, no nav link). Chose Hướng B (retire): deleted app/doc-compare/*, lib/pipelines/workflows/doc-compare.ts + prompts, mock-service ext-doc-compare response + connectors.js entry. Verified nothing else imported it; build + typecheck clean.

decisions.title: Navigation Page Registry & App Launcher
decisions.decision: Centralized all navigable pages in lib/navigation/registry.ts (single source of truth) with group/role/status/icon/description metadata. HeaderNav renders a registry-driven 'Cong cu' dropdown (keeps existing pill style). Added /apps launcher (full directory). Internal/BU pages visible to all users with 'internal' badge. doc-compare marked deprecated (process not in workflow registry -> 404).

conventions.naming: Kebab-case for API endpoints, camelCase for TypeScript, snake_case for database fields
conventions.file_structure: Next.js App Router structure with lib/ for business logic, separate worker.ts process
conventions.code_style: TypeScript with strict types, ESLint + Prettier

known_issues: Test coverage cần được cải thiện - có tests nhưng chưa đủ coverage
